## Workflow and outcome

Who needs this, what concrete operation should be possible, and what result should they see?

## Current workaround

Describe what you do today and the part the bridge cannot handle.

## Scope and evidence

If applicable, link the exact official Adobe UXP member and minimum version. Explain whether it reads data, changes a working sequence, changes shared assets/UI/global state, saves or starts a native job. Unknowns are welcome; catalog presence is not runtime proof.

Use synthetic examples. Do not include private projects, media or paths. The bridge exposes explicit tools; it does not provide an autonomous editing policy.
